letter: My dearest Liza, my jaan, every sunrise in Dubai and every monsoon breeze in Ahmedabad reminds me how lucky I am to share this beautiful chaos with you. Today, as the calendar whispers “23‑02‑2025” in the background, I feel the same flutter I felt on our wedding day, only louder. You’re my cutie, my confidante, my endless source of laughter and love. Thank you for turning ordinary moments into golden memories. I adore you more with each passing second, and I can’t wait for all the adventures still ahead.
poem:
In desert dunes or city rain,  
Your smile erases every pain.  
Together, love, we dance and rhyme,  
Forever yours, till end of time.
